definitions.explanation: A face that shows signs of crying or being about to cry. Can describe someone currently crying or someone whose face shows traces of recent tears.

examples.japanese: {泣|な}き{顔|がお}を{見|み}せないで。
examples.english: Don't show me your crying face.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{泣|な}き{顔|がお}を{見|み}ると{胸|むね}が{痛|いた}む。
examples.english: It pains my heart to see a child's tearful face.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{泣|な}き{顔|がお}のまま{部屋|へや}を{出|で}て{行|い}った。
examples.english: She left the room with tears still on her face.

notes: A compound of {泣|な}く (to cry) + {顔|かお} (face), where {顔|かお} voices to がお. Part of a productive pattern of ～{顔|がお} compounds describing facial expressions: {笑|え}み{顔|がお} (smiling face), {怒|おこ}り{顔|がお} (angry face), {困|こま}り{顔|がお} (troubled face). Often used with を{見|み}せる (to show) or になる (to become).
